versions.changelog:
Initial release of EVM Transaction Safety Preview.

- Provides a free, lightweight pre-signing triage to help agents verify EVM transactions before signing.
- Checks chain, contract address, calldata intent, value/allowance, token/contract risk, and simulation posture.
- Designed as a checklist only; does not sign or broadcast transactions.
- Promotes safe transaction habits and guides users to the paid ClawMart toolkit for deeper live checks and simulations.
- Enforces safety limits and highlights common anti-patterns to avoid.
